title: Constructor Does Not Validate vault.asset() Matches underlyingToken
rootCause: The constructor accepts _underlyingToken and _erc4626Vault as separate parameters but never verifies that IERC4626(_erc4626Vault).asset() == _underlyingToken. A misconfigured deployment would silently create a broken strategy.
impact: Deployment misconfiguration risk. Deposits would fail or succeed with wrong token accounting.
